content: The cube flies down
And unfolds into a quaint and beautiful bakery
It magical forms with all the latest cooking gadgets in it
(YASSSS)
It smells of beautiful sweet bread and fresh croissants every morning
This is your new home now. You own it, and nothing will take it from you
<@!360967589511561218> give me a random dc pls
A little gift basket lies on the steps up to the bakery

A note inside says
```You are off to do amazing things, I can't wait to try the pastries you make next. With Love - Sir Florian Chapelle, Le Rêveur```
It holds a French cookbook, Florian's family cookbook.
Croissants on page 1 of course
https://tenor.com/view/heart-emoji-gif-3555133
Whether its the sugar rush or the excitement or the crying Goose passes out, but with a smile

(Just letting you all know, I will be on a 3 day trip and i will return Thursday night. 
Until then I think this is the perfect time for Goose to set up their shop- so i will be putting up some "pre-rp" (that's the best name I got) 

That involves some of your characters. Rp w character will be in downtime (like jobs) and have no need to be interacted with. 
I'm planning to set a pre-rp every day until I return.

**Bc of my absence/no signal, any additions or changes can't happen :c** ) 

<@!360967589511561218> thank you for pinning

.
Goose wakes up from thier (conviniently timed) faint, a little groggy but smiles nonetheless at their new place. It only seemed like a dream, so forgiegn yet nostalgic. They take the time to explore what everything does. Too distracted at the sheer 'newness' of everthing, the morning draft brings the scent of crossaints and sweetbreads wakes them up fully. 

"Oh *honk* theres a lot to do"

.
They pick up the basket and examine the book. They don't understand ANYthing and just sighs. They carefully place the book in their bag, making sure it wouldn't damage/get damage by anything else in the bag, and head off to Copper's.
"I mean mayors kinda need to read right?"

.
Goose walks in with a cookbook and asks Copper for help. Copper helps them read, but seeing how goose seems more puzzled, he tried to help teach goose how to read and write. This kinda worked...kinda. Goose is somehow more understanding but also more confused about them. They keep on mixing up 'u' and 'n' and well as 'q' 'p' 'g' 'y' and 'j'.
+ 1 on (some??) reading comprehension (i guess??)

.
Carefully swaddling the cook book they head over to Florian's ( <@!360967589511561218> ) , who is more than ecstatic to show how to make croissants and baguettes. The practice wasn't for naught as Goose can make a bread basket full of the fluffiest breads. For all the less visually appealing (but still delicious) attempts they wrap them in cloth and deliver them to the orphanage. The aroma of fresh bread brings a sudden joyous cries of children upon the open door. With the bread aplenty, the children take a liking to "Mr. Duck". Despite the misnomer, Goose had to stifle a tear of fulfillment.

Goose had to pry the children off themselves with promises of returning soon.

.
They fly over to <#739565107092389939> ( <@!361351593292988425> ) and drop off a basket of choice baguettes and croissants with a note that is barely legible
```bRaed foRM GoOse```

Goose knocks on <@!260820438026813440>  and/or <@!470420431841656833>  door, shyly asking if they can teach them how to make crepes. They agree and together they went through some trial and error to help Goose master a crepe. Goose takes note of the jam and implore someone for a recipe. Goose decides to pay them as a token of thanks (100 gp to those who teach goose, put a 💟  emoji to claim).

Next they meet up with <@!692746345387130900> , <@!519566652824616973> , and/or <@!321508500138360843>  and ask to be taught how to make their hot chocolate and madeleines, with special interest in the candied flowers. The Hot chocolate was simple enough, and the madeleines proved to be a obstacle but eventually learnt- it was the candied flowers that frustrated goose the most. 

But someone suggested that the copious amounts of burnt sugar (goose really tried) could be used as a element in other bread, such as syrup, topping, or cooled to bark candy shards. Before they leave Goose insists they take some money for their talents (100 gp to those who teach goose, put a 💟  emoji to claim).

.
Goose manages to flag <@!264570136025890816>  down and ask about the Macarons. Truth is Goose wanted to try one at the competition but was swiftly devoured by the judges (and Florian). Despite all the trials and tribulations, Goose (and every youtube baker I've seen) couldn't seem to get it right. Wynne pats Goose and explain that it's a difficult recipe requiring lots of practice and accuracy. Although unsatisfied Goose still offered gold in return for their time.(100 gp to those who teach goose, put a 💟  emoji to claim).

Goose walks into <#739055206330793994>  to purchase some fruits to experiment. (300 gp to Cobblepot and Rosewood <@!264570136025890816> <@!519566652824616973> ) Goose is thankful for saving up thier money.

.
While walking past the Oasis, they thought of Sandigill. "He was one of the first person I met...". They enter and their eyes go wide at how beautiful the place is, but they eventually see the sandiberries- they gasp. They put down their groceries and take a gander at the tree. They examine the berries at all angles. Seeing 5 in total, they shyly pick one off and continue to analyze it. After some slow rotating in their palm they pick off two more, stopping themselves to not get too greedy. They cradle the berries with full intention to not drop them, hitch the groceries on their hip and head home.
(DM's note: There are 2 sandiberries left in the Oasis on 8/18)

.
Goose will spend all night recreating recipes and experimenting with toppings and fillings. Any (poor) neighbor will hear faint pans clanging, a small-ish explosion, and distressed honking. After that debacle, they make some key notes
```Burn sugar more doesn't make more sweet
Vegetable jam work???
Bake bread at 19250 degrees 1 minute bread...NO AGAIN, stop pleas
orange syrup yes
meat crepe don't work, missing some?? thing
Soot oil out of feather, how??
Clic Clac of tongs = happi
red Berries blue berry together good yes
RANDY YOUR STICKS
Find small jar, baby jam, tiny jam
Hot Cocolate simple, Hot coco favorite```

When Goose finally rests, they collapse into their nest. They look up to their ceiling and have a big stupid grin. "I feel alive, I feel fulfilled, I feel excited to live another day, I feel-" a cacophony of a snore and honk haunts the house. Thank all the gods Goose doesn't have a roommate.

Web absolutely helps goose learn the recipe, showing them what consistency to mix the batter, how to make it thin, how to get the edges crispy and the inside soft and luscious, and how to learn to do it over and over until it's perfect. They give Goose a recipe for the crepes and make sure goose knows they can talk to Web about them whenever. They also help goose learn how to properly do meat crepes: it's all in making the meat tender enough to tear off softly with the rest of the bite, as well as making the sauce the right consistency for the crepe.
(consider that noted <3)
(yee)
Web also gives goose a special recipe for mushroom-fish crepes. They are very good.
(Edited messages to be read easier, was causing eyestrain)
<@456226577798135808> Cookbook is in pictures and easily understood with DC 7 insight check
Oof Ill keep that in mind next time
<@456226577798135808> btw take an inspiration point

Florian visits every morning at dawn to provide a single helping hand to bake new recipes, and teaching Goose how to read when he can. Especially the cookbook. He makes sure the techniques are passed on to some worthy creature, and he believes in Goose. By the end of the week, Goose will have a fairly good grasp on many French pastries and other desserts. Any roll made to cook a Croissant that is 15 or lower instead turns into a 16.

Selene leaves <@456226577798135808> their candied flower petal recipe:
```-Very carefully pluck the individual edible petals from the bloom.
Gently wash the petals, trying not to bruise them. Place the petals on towels and let them be until they’re completely dry.
-Crack egg white into a small bowl and whisk it with a fork. Dump the superfine honey-sugar into a shallow bowl.
-Gently paint a petal with the egg white using a new soft bristle brush, turning to coat both sides and allowing any extra to drop off, and then place the petal in the bowl of superfine sugar, turning to coat both sides and sprinkling on extra, if necessary, so the petals are completely coated with honey-sugar.
-Space the candied petals apart on a cooling rack and leave until dry and hardened.
-Use the candied rose petals the same day as they’ll become soft and wet if left too long.```

Early on the morning, Florian ( <@!360967589511561218> ) knocks on Goose’s door with a stack of elementary schoolbooks. Goose opens the door to see Florian’s expression of wholesome giddiness. Which changes quickly, as Goose stands there in the pinkest frilliest apron paired with the darkest undereye (can Aaracokras have dark under eyes?). Goose doesn’t notice how strange their attire is.

.
They’re expression changes to happiness upon seeing Florian and invites him in. After a quick exchange, Florian gets promptly seated with a hot chocolate, madeleine, and crepes. Goose sits across him and stares. Their gaze quickly switches from Florian to the platter. Florian gives his hearty French laugh and samples each dessert. Goose watches, with bated breath.

.
Although ultimately, Florian liked them- it was not the reaction Goose wanted (got okayish rolls :/ ) . Before Goose asks suggestions on how to improve, they’re met face to face with a book
```Phonics with Florian```
(will Goose read with a French accent then?) XD

Of course, Goose tries to remind him that ‘they’re Goose, 19-’, Florian gives his usual charming smile as he tells Goose he’s gonna teach him how to read. Before Goose can even form a syllable, Florian (metaphysically) drags them along for the wonderful world of reading and writing. A flurry of alphabets, words, and grammar is bombed onto the unsuspecting bird. Goose is now slightly disheveled, trying to keep their writing fast enough for ‘class’. Another new letter, another word, another “sound”. Florian keeps a perfect smile as Goose tries to attempt a crawl to escape. “Reading its fundamental!” rings out as Goose is pulled back.

.
A distressing honk can be heard.
Goose levels up in reading and writing!

.
Goose thanks Florian profusely and profess how much more confident they feel. Florian stand a little taller with hand on his lapels “I will return tomorrow with more advanced lessons!” Goose lets him know a platter of French treats will be waiting for him. Saying their goodbyes, Goose turns around. Before they can head back inside, they notice scratches on the dirt of their doorway. Whatever made those scratches seemed really desperate to leave. Goose looks closely at the marks, their detective instinct active. Unfortunately, that instinct is pretty bad so they just shrug and ignore it.

.
Despite Goose still rocking them e-girl red eyeshadow undereye, they stretch, yawn, and start a big day. “Man, a business is something you really got to work for.” Goose thought as they sit at their desk. They ponder a bit on what else they should do. Practice baking? Goose think they deserve a break. Learn new recipes? They think on it and figured they should use their new reading skills to the test. They open Florian’s gift and with a stunning roll of...2 (ASKAJSKJ BRO THE DC WAS 7) their cumulative exhaustion from bake-a-thon and ‘Phonics with Florian’, causes words to blur before their eyes. They immediately close the book and hold their head in their hands.

.
They’ll admit it, they took a nap- but it wasn’t long before <@!321508500138360843>  knocked. Except, their politeness didn't wake up Goose right away. It kept on escalating to a point where Selene just sighs and leaves a note.

.
You know who isn't afraid to be not-polite? <@!260820438026813440> . Just when Selene leaves Web comes along, eager to pass along what they learned from Bashara. They pick up Selene's note, and kindly starts banging on the doors. Web hears what they think is Goose saying “I DONT WANNA LEARN WHAT RHYMES WITH CAT!!!” After a little while, the door cracks open a little bit. Upon seeing Web, Goose opens the door wide and welcomes them.

.
Goose puts down a ```tw for gross old food``` ||a chartruise board of weevil infested hardtack, jerky with white stuff, moldy dried fruit, and a spoiled fruit jam with fermented rice|| for Web. They even give a couple breads on the go, so web can wait until they’re ‘aged’. They have a lovely conversation, and Goose tells Web all about their adventures yesterday and even proudly present their notes last night. Web easily reads the notes, as they understand the simple grammar- even so they get confused on some parts, where goose happily jumps in and clarifies. 
.
Once Web heard and read about the macaron and meat crepe incident they decided they gotta take control. They lead Goose over to the kitchen and start to guide them on the precision of baking macarons; from the exact grams to the exact handiwork. Although tired, Goose happily learns. Of course, Goose is very grateful of the cookbook, they figure they rather learn by experience then reading - at least at the moment.

.
The process takes up a lot of time. Web wouldn’t let up until Goose made a perfect batch. Even when that’s achieved Web excited shows Goose how a meat crepe would work. They would need to prepare the meat to be as tender as possible, as well as a sauce that will compliment the meat and bring in the whole crepe.

.
‘So throwing jerky at a crepe isn't gonna cut it’ goose figures

.
When Web looked at the time, they excused themself- but not without reassuring Goose that they shouldn’t be shy when it comes to asking for help. Goose invites them to the back of the store for more ‘aged’ morsels. Before they forget Web leaves Goose with Selene's note and a couple words of encouragement.

.
Goose ogles at their perfect macaron. They tentively grab a piece like if it was glass baby. (UNLIKE glass babies) Goose takes a bite out of the treat. Their mouth sings at the marinades of textures. It reminds them of those pink cloud like candy they used to see children carry after a town carnival. Unfortunately, whenever they got their beak on one and take it back to their lake, the cloud disappears? But this, this is what goose always thought it would taste like. They look at the rest of the failed/unappealing batches. They have to admit today’s taste testing made them feel like that was enough sweets for a goose (think eating a Cadbury crème egg; just a assault of sugar).

.
The door opens and Goose gets attacked with a barrage of children screaming “IT’S MR DUCK!!!” After the giggles and tomfoolery, Goose laughs it off and produces many boxes tired with colored twine. Inside was the result of all the extra baking of all types of crepes, madeleines, breads with topping, and macarons. The orphanage caretaker scolds Goose for the hyperactivity of the kids from all the sugar, but her eyes shine- clearly happy for the children to smile. While the children snack, Goose tells them their adventures (with all the gory and inappropriate bits left out). They let children use him as a playground, hanging from their biceps and try to jump touch “Mr. Duck’s” head. They show off their wings to the orphan’s request, and explain how bird fly (no, it not *magic*...at least not all the time). One of their favorite things to do is to read them bed time stories; its good practice for Goose’s vocabulary and reading skills. (Also Goose would totally join in on nap time)

.
They get home VERY exhausted, but still happy. As they clean up the kitchen, they notice two small jars. They forgot what they out it in. They dip a finger in and tasted it. The moment they swallowed, their exhaustion felt lighter - its not gone - but it is significantly lighter. They stare at it, and suddenly shoot up - to go to bed because they need rest, but they plan to do some serious research the next day… and figure out how to make candied flowers.

.
Goose dreams of shrunken in a field of candied flowers.
Web lets goose know they'd be happy to help with establishing a long-term and customizable yeast colony for bread. Yeast are fungi after all.

Goose leaps out the bed, they give themself a hype HONK before bounding out the door- which had open out to Florian’s (<@!360967589511561218> ) face. Goose frantically apologizes; Florian recovers quickly, and waves off Goose’s barrage of sorry’s. He gets hurried in, while Goose zooms off into the kitchen. They come back out with a tiny chef hat and a platter of macarons in different flavors as well as a curious little jar of jam. The macarons were delicious- of course not as delicious as ( <@!264570136025890816>  ), which was a culmination of their many years of experience. Either way, Florian liked it and let Goose know with a fitting “*mmmm*, zis is - ah how you say - *magnifique*”.

. 
But one stood out to Florian, and Goose anticipated this moment. The yellow macaron popped into Florian’s mouth and his eyes open wide. It enveloped the mouth in richness and sweetness. He implores, wanting to know what it’s ingredients are. Goose gives a sly smile and lets him know it’s a secret. They point to the jam and encourages Florian to taste it. Florian tries some and yet again it’s the same main ingredient. It’s awfully nostalgic but he cant quite place his finger on it yet ( <@!360967589511561218> Roll 1d20 History DC 5 for ). Nevertheless, it’s classtime.
